question.text: Target allocation 70% equity, 30% debt on a Rs. 2 crore portfolio. After a rally, equity is Rs. 1.6 cr and debt Rs. 40 lakh. Rebalance action:

answer.text: Sell Rs. 20 lakh equity, buy Rs. 20 lakh debt

explanation.text: The Logic: Current = 80/20 on Rs. 2 cr => target Rs. 1.4 cr equity / Rs. 60 lakh debt. Sell Rs. 20L equity, add to debt. The Trap: Hold ignores drift; sell-all is excessive. Cross-Exam Context: Mechanical rebalance used in X-A, X-B. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Use fresh inflows to rebalance tax-efficiently before outright sales.
